mainEntity.name: Can I hire an interior designer after construction has already started?

acceptedAnswer.text: While it's possible to hire an interior designer after construction has begun, it may limit their ability to influence fundamental structural or layout decisions, potentially leading to more complex and costly changes. The impact on the project timeline and budget can be higher due to re-work or adjustments needed for late-stage design input. Ideally, an interior designer should be involved from the planning stage to optimize integration.
acceptedAnswer.description: Hiring an interior designer after construction starts is possible but may limit their influence on structural decisions and could lead to more costly changes and timeline impacts.
